body.message:
We completely understand your frustration regarding the delay in receiving your refund, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

We has provided all the required details and has already followed up on the matter with the concerned team. Unfortunately, the refund cannot be processed directly from our end, as it must go through the required management approval process.

We have also highlighted the urgency of your refund and requested that it be expedited as much as possible. We truly understand how important it is for you to receive the funds, and we sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding while we work to have this resolved.

As soon as we receive any further update or confirmation, we will inform you immediately.

Thank you once again for your patience and kind understanding.
